data.one_liner: Intercepts Dio requests and prints them as curl commands in the debug panel.
data.what_it_does: It intercepts Dio HTTP requests and generates equivalent cURL commands in the debug output. This allows developers to easily copy and paste requests into a terminal, Postman, or Insomnia for replaying and debugging.
use_when: You need to quickly debug and replay Dio HTTP requests in a terminal or Postman
You want to share exact cURL representations of app requests with backend developers
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive network inspector UI rather than terminal text logs
strengths: Simple to set up with Dio interceptors
Supports FormData conversion to plain maps for file uploads
weaknesses: Only prints to the debug panel/terminal
Limited to request logging and cURL generation
data.setup_notes: Just add the interceptor to your Dio instance.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a pretty printer for Dio request, response, and error logs if you prefer a detailed formatted log output instead of cURL commands.
